direction-type.words: This waltz is in what I would consider to be a Quasi-Sonata Form. It isn't your typical Sonata Form, but it is quite similar
to Sonata Form. The first A section you could consider to be the Exposition, the B section and Digression, you could
consider both to be part of the Development section, and the second A section, you could consider to be the Recapitulation.
Or you could just say that the waltz is in an atypical Ternary Form and leave it at that. Either way you look at it, it isn't in a
typical form for the genre. I personally would describe this as a Quasi-Sonata Form though, because of the significance of
each section and each theme in each section, including the Coda.
